cues.en: In this lecture, I will provide an overview of the forward pass of artificial neural networks and how
cues.zh: 這堂課會概述人工神經網路的前向傳播，以及，

cues.en: those operations are stored and implemented in the PyTorch library.
cues.zh: 這些運算如何在 PyTorch 裡儲存與實作。

cues.en: Not to be honest, if this is the first time you are ever seeing this material, then you will probably find the main part of this course to be a little challenging.
cues.zh: 老實說，如果你第一次看到這些內容，可能會覺得這門課的主要部分有點挑戰。

cues.en: So I hope that you already have some exposure to deep learning in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 所以，希望你之前已經接觸過 PyTorch 深度學習。

cues.en: And this lecture is some review and maybe also some additional novel explorations.
cues.zh: 這堂課既是複習，也可能提供一些新的探索。

cues.en: This slide is a reminder of the fundamental mechanism of artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 這張投影片提醒我們，人工神經網路的基本機制。

cues.en: We have a unit here which unfortunately is called a neuron.
cues.zh: 這裡有個單元，可惜大家把它叫做神經元。

cues.en: It's unfortunate naming because this has literally nothing whatsoever to do with actual biological neurons, not in their form or their function or their calculations.
cues.zh: 這個名稱不太恰當，因為不論形式、功能或計算，它和真正生物神經元都完全沒有關係。

cues.en: But that's how it goes.
cues.zh: 但大家就是這樣叫。

cues.en: Anyway, the x's here are inputs into this unit, and the W's are the weights.
cues.zh: 總之，x 是這個單元的輸入，w 是權重。

cues.en: Now this one over here x0 is colored differently because this is called the bias term.
cues.zh: 這邊的 x_0 用不同顏色，因為它叫做偏置項。

cues.en: It's an offset that doesn't actually come from anything in the data.
cues.zh: 是一個偏移量，不是直接來自資料。

cues.en: It's just an extra number that gets added to this unit.
cues.zh: 只是額外加進單元的一個數字。

cues.en: That allows the unit to shift its distribution of activations, which turns out to be really useful for the model's performance.
cues.zh: 讓單元能平移活化值的分布，這對模型表現很有幫助。

cues.en: It's the same thing as an intercept term in a regression.
cues.zh: 和迴歸裡的截距相同。

cues.en: Anyway, this unit here calculates a weighted sum of these inputs, which is then passed through an
cues.zh: 這個單元計算輸入的加權總和，再送進，

cues.en: activation function, typically a non-linear activation function like ReLU or Jlu or sigmoid, depending
cues.zh: 活化函式，通常是非線性的，例如 ReLU、GELU 或 sigmoid，取決於，

cues.en: on the specific network architecture and the goal of this unit.
cues.zh: 具體的網路架構，以及這個單元的目標。

cues.en: So this is one unit.
cues.zh: 這就是一個單元。

cues.en: And then in practice, you stitch lots of these units together in different layers of the model.
cues.zh: 實務上，把很多單元組合起來，排成模型的不同層。

cues.en: All the way over here to the left we have the inputs that actually are coming from the data measured from the outside world.
cues.zh: 最左邊的輸入，真的來自外界測量的資料。

cues.en: Maybe these are pixel values from an image.
cues.zh: 可能是影像像素。

cues.en: Maybe they are numerical values corresponding to medical information, or maybe they are numbered tokens that come from written language.
cues.zh: 可能是醫療資訊的數值，也可能是文字語言轉換而來、帶編號的詞元。

cues.en: And then all the way at this side of the model you have some output, which is a prediction that the model makes about the world.
cues.zh: 模型另一端則有輸出，是模型對世界做的預測。

cues.en: Again, maybe that's a simple binary prediction, like whether a patient has a disease or not, or maybe it's a prediction about which word should be printed Did next.
cues.zh: 可能是病人是否患病這種簡單二元預測，也可能預測下一個應該出現的字。

cues.en: And then all of these layers in the middle are called hidden layers, because they are not directly connected to data from the outside world.
cues.zh: 中間這些層，叫做隱藏層，因為不直接連接外界資料。

cues.en: But here's the thing.
cues.zh: 但重點是，

cues.en: All of these units, I engage in identical calculations.
cues.zh: 這些單元，進行的計算相同。

cues.en: They're all doing exactly the same thing, which is linear weighted sum, and that is implemented as
cues.zh: 全部都在做相同的事情，也就是線性加權總和，透過，

cues.en: the dot product between the inputs, so the x's and the corresponding weights.
cues.zh: 輸入 x 和對應權重之間的內積實作。

cues.en: And then that is passed through a simple nonlinear activation function.
cues.zh: 再送進簡單的非線性活化函式。

cues.en: Of course the values of the inputs and the values of the weights are different for each unit, but the elementary mathematical operation is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 當然，各單元的輸入值與權重值不同，但基本數學運算相同。

cues.en: Now notice the direction of the arrows on this graph.
cues.zh: 注意圖裡箭頭的方向。

cues.en: They all go from the input which corresponds to real world data, images or text, and all the outputs flow to the right towards the output.
cues.zh: 全部從代表影像或文字等真實資料的輸入出發，向右流往輸出。

cues.en: So that is called the forward pass where information flows from input.
cues.zh: 這叫做前向傳播，資訊從輸入，

cues.en: So initial input to the final output of the deep learning model.
cues.zh: 也就是最初的輸入，流到模型的最終輸出。

cues.en: It's also sometimes called the feed forward pass or the forward sweep or something similar.
cues.zh: 有時也叫 feed-forward pass、forward sweep 等等。

cues.en: There's a couple of different terms that people use now with modern architectures.
cues.zh: 大家使用的名稱有幾種；不過，現代架構裡，

cues.en: It's not necessarily the case that all the information only goes forward.
cues.zh: 資訊不一定都只往前。

cues.en: Sometimes there are recurrent connections where a little bit of residual information is fed back from later layers to earlier layers, but that's more the occasional exception.
cues.zh: 有時有循環連結，把後層的一點殘留資訊回饋到前層，但這比較像偶爾的例外。

cues.en: Mostly information flows forwards from the initial inputs, from the data, all the way to the output during the forward pass.
cues.zh: 大部分時候，前向傳播的資訊從原始輸入資料，一路流到輸出。

cues.en: Okay, then we have backpropagation, often abbreviated backprop.
cues.zh: 接著是反向傳播，經常縮寫為 backprop。

cues.en: Backprop only occurs during model training, not when you're actually using the model for applications.
cues.zh: 反向傳播只發生在訓練時，實際使用模型做應用時不會。

cues.en: So backprop involves adjusting each of these weights, each of these arrows according to the model's performance.
cues.zh: 反向傳播會依模型表現，調整每個權重，也就是每條箭頭。

cues.en: So if the model is not performing very well, then it will adjust the values of these weights to increase the performance on the next batch.
cues.zh: 如果表現不好，就調整權重，讓下一批次表現更好。

cues.en: But anyway, I'm just focusing on the forward pass in this video.
cues.zh: 不過，這支影片只專注前向傳播。

cues.en: Now for language models the architecture is a little bit more complicated.
cues.zh: 語言模型的架構稍微複雜。

cues.en: So we have at the inputs a numerical representations of characters and words.
cues.zh: 輸入端，是字元與單字的數值表示。

cues.en: Those are called tokens.
cues.zh: 這些叫做詞元。

cues.en: So those are the inputs that are coming in.
cues.zh: 就是輸入的內容。

cues.en: Then we have lots of hidden layers.
cues.zh: 接著有很多隱藏層。

cues.en: Now in large language models these have very specific architectures.
cues.zh: 大型語言模型裡，這些層有很特定的架構。

cues.en: They're called attention heads and so on.
cues.zh: 例如注意力頭等等。

cues.en: But in a conceptual sense they are basically just hidden layers because they do not directly receive
cues.zh: 但概念上，基本仍然是隱藏層，因為它們不直接，

cues.en: input from the outside world, nor are they directly connected to the outputs of the model.
cues.zh: 接收外界輸入，也不直接連到模型的輸出。

cues.en: And then the outputs of a language model correspond to, or at least can be transformed into the probabilities
cues.zh: 語言模型的輸出，則對應，或者至少可以轉換成選擇，

cues.en: of selecting tokens, which are then translated into pieces of text like characters and words.
cues.zh: 詞元的機率，再把詞元轉回字元與單字等文字片段。

cues.en: Now the thing is.
cues.zh: 重點是，

cues.en: That we like to think about these units or artificial neurons.
cues.zh: 我們喜歡把這些單元，也就是人工神經元，

cues.en: We think about them as being the atoms of computation in the models.
cues.zh: 當成模型計算的最小基本單位。

cues.en: But in practice, in the actual Python implementation, you don't actually construct these units directly.
cues.zh: 但實務上，在 Python 裡，不會直接一個個建立這些單元。

cues.en: They are implicitly created.
cues.zh: 它們是隱含建立的。

cues.en: Instead, we create the matrices that correspond to all of these weights or all of these arrows here.
cues.zh: 相反地，會建立對應這些權重，也就是圖裡所有箭頭的矩陣。

cues.en: And that is implemented through a PyTorch class called linear with a capital L, so nn dot linear.
cues.zh: 這透過 PyTorch 的 Linear 類別實作，L 要大寫，也就是 nn.Linear。

cues.en: So when you see non-linear in the code, that's actually creating these matrices that correspond to the weights, which are all of the arrows that I'm drawing in this diagram.
cues.zh: 所以，在程式碼裡看到 nn.Linear，就是建立對應所有這些箭頭、所有權重的矩陣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.zh: 這在代表初始化的 __init__ 裡完成。

cues.en: Then down here we have the forward pass which is implementing the weighted linear sum plus non-linearity that I described a few slides ago.
cues.zh: 下面則是前向傳播，實作前幾張投影片介紹的線性加權總和，加上非線性。

cues.en: Now you don't actually literally see any calculations being done in here, but I'm going to show you
cues.zh: 這裡看不到明寫的計算，但會示範，

cues.zh: 例如如何重現 self.embedding 實際做的事情。

cues.en: Then we are going to create an instance of that model, inspect its properties and see how to access some of the parts, like for example, the weights matrices.

cues.en: The next thing we will do is manually calculate a forward pass using dot products as implemented through
cues.zh: 然後，使用由矩陣乘法實作的內積，手動計算，

cues.en: matrix multiplication, and we will see that our manual calculations perfectly reconstruct what PyTorch
cues.zh: 前向傳播，會看到手動計算能完全重現 PyTorch，

cues.en: is doing using its NN linear class.
cues.zh: 透過 nn.Linear 類別所做的事情。

cues.en: Finally, I will illustrate to you the basic concept of using a language model for next token prediction.
cues.zh: 最後，示範語言模型進行下一詞元預測的基本概念。

cues.en: What we're going to do is start with some text, translate that text into numbers, push all of those
cues.zh: 先有一段文字，轉換成數字，再把這些數字，

cues.zh: 透過前向傳播送進模型，預測後續詞元。

cues.zh: ChatGPT 等真正語言模型，運作方式就是如此。

cues.zh: 但當然，這裡只是帶有隨機數、沒有訓練的小矩陣，ChatGPT 則極其，

cues.en: Here is where we will create our own class for a simple deep learning model.
cues.zh: 這裡要建立自己的類別，代表一個簡單深度學習模型。

cues.en: Now the thing is, in PyTorch we need to keep track of a lot of little variables, components of the computational graphs, gradients, and so on.
cues.zh: 在 PyTorch 裡，需要追蹤很多小變數、計算圖的組件、梯度等等。

cues.en: So there's a lot of methods and properties and attributes that any deep learning model in PyTorch needs
cues.zh: 所以，每個 PyTorch 深度學習模型，都需要很多方法、特性與屬性，

cues.en: to have that we do not want to have to rewrite every single time we create a new model.
cues.zh: 我們不想每次建立模型，都重新寫一次。

cues.zh: 因此，從 nn.Module 繼承許多方法與屬性。

cues.zh: 不需要在類別裡一項一項明寫。

cues.zh: 好的。

cues.zh: 也就是二十六個字母，加上空格。

cues.en: We're going to use that for pushing data through the model later.
cues.zh: 稍後會用它，把資料送進模型。

cues.en: And then 100 is just kind of an arbitrary number that I chose.
cues.zh: 一百則只是我隨意選的數字。

cues.zh: 是隱藏層的單元數。
